name: DlightRAG · p95 of a run-answer span is at least five minutes
message: p95 of run-answer duration crossed five minutes; this window's p95 is {{value}} nanoseconds, against a threshold of 300000000000 (five minutes, the unit Duration is stored in). a slow answer is usually one provider call or one tool loop, so open the slowest run in the traces table first.

chartConfig.name: p95 run-answer duration
chartConfig.sqlTemplate:
SELECT quantile(0.95)(Duration) AS p95_duration_ns
FROM otel_traces
WHERE startsWith(ServiceName, 'dlightrag')
  AND SpanName = 'run-answer'
  AND $__timeFilter_ms(Timestamp)
